title: DeepSeek-R1 Release
summary: DeepSeek publicly released DeepSeek-R1 on January 20, 2025. Its official release announcement states that the model weights were released under the MIT License and that the model was available through DeepSeek's website and API.
significance: A documented public release milestone for DeepSeek-R1, an openly released reasoning-model system with public model weights and API availability.

verification.note: DeepSeek's first-party January 20, 2025 release announcement directly establishes the public release date, model-weight release under the MIT License, and website/API availability. DeepSeek's API documentation independently records the same release milestone and API model name. The date is attached only to this documented public-release event; no development date, geography, ancestry, influence, causal relationship, or unsupported precision is inferred.
